advice: Review drug history (DPP-4 inhibitors). Drain tense blisters with sterile needle, keep roof intact. Monitor sugar and BP. If oral prednisolone is used: add calcium + vitamin D, PPI if GI risk; check sugar and BP regularly. Doxycycline and nicotinamide: avoid antacids/iron within 2 hours of doxycycline.
name: Bullous pemphigoid

rx.instr: Apply on whole body (sparing face) once daily; taper over months
